why: finding 4 on natural text (Dan, 23 Oct): which SQuAD items the model answers from the paragraph, from the answer's sentence alone, not without it, and not after another article's paragraph
format: chat template, thinking off, 'Answer:' prefilled (BJ_FORMAT=chat); the user turn: paragraph, newline, question, 'Answer with a few words copied from the text and nothing else.'

prompts.deleted: the paragraph without the answer's sentence

read: one forward per prompt: right iff the answer's first token (after 'Answer:', with its space) is the top token (suite_v1.read_answers' margin > 0)
greedy: full only: 12 new tokens; right iff a gold answer's normalised text (SQuAD's normalisation) is inside the normalised first non-empty line
eligibility: full: first token right and greedy right; alone: first token right (the answer's sentence suffices); deleted: first token wrong (the answer needs that sentence)
